blurb: Three Belles Marina offers boating and fishing facilities including moorings, wet slips, and marine services. It is a certified Clean Marina since 2010 and generates 100% of its own electricity since 2018. The marina hosts waterfront events such as eco tours, glow paddles, paddle board yoga, and sunset paddles.
